method: After the full 265,809-bar integrated PRIMARY replay, a FRESH BasketLedger object reconstructs every basket solely from the durable append-only records (no in-memory harness state), mirroring a process restart.

evidence.per_basket_events: SIGNAL_OBSERVED -> BASKET_INTENT_CREATED -> ENTRY_ATTEMPT_STARTED -> LEG_FILL_CONFIRMED x3 -> BASKET_OPEN_VERIFIED -> EXIT_SIGNAL_OBSERVED -> EXIT_ATTEMPT_STARTED -> BASKET_CLOSED_VERIFIED
evidence.r3_durable_only_test: R3 test reconstruction_solely_from_durable_records (40/40 suite) proves reconstruction from durable records alone
evidence.write_ahead: BASKET_INTENT_CREATED persisted BEFORE any execution; ENTRY_ATTEMPT_STARTED before broker action; EXIT_SIGNAL_OBSERVED before close attempt

note: open_verified_at_terminal = 0 because all 194 baskets completed their lifecycle to CLOSED_VERIFIED; 194 BASKET_OPEN_VERIFIED events exist in the ledger.
